title: EEG neurofeedback 'chair' sessions targeting theta and gamma
summary: Jordan Jose tells of EEG neurofeedback 'chair' sessions targeting theta and gamma, about c. 2008–2010 at Baker Victory Services, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, says that around 2008 to 2010 he had sessions at Baker Victory Services in Western New York in what he calls "the chair." These were EEG neurofeedback sessions, where sensors read the brain's electrical waves, here aimed at the kinds called theta and gamma. Jose says this is where many of his traumatic memories came back to him.
